description: The Milnor deficit sign (−1)^{A−1} (#4389) and the Ocneanu-weight bar-sign (−1)^{n-1} (#4399) agree in VALUE but not MECHANISM. The proved Borromean deficit h⁴(3+h²)/(h²+4) has leading order h⁴=h^{2(A−1)} with the weight prefactor h^{n-1}=h⁸ ABSENT (τ_A is a normalized ratio ⇒ the weight cancels), and is bar-even (sign is a coefficient effect). The weight order 3A−1 strictly exceeds the deficit order 2(A−1), so the (cancelled, subleading) weight parity CANNOT set the deficit sign. Hence the weight-parity ⇒ deficit-sign derivation route is REFUTED (scope-a); the (−1)^{A−1} match is a convergence via distinct mechanisms, not a derivation — sharpening #4399 Tie B and forbidding it being passed off as a derivation of the sign law #4389 leaves open. Lean-proved order/parity facts (MilnorWeightParityConvergence.lean). scope-(a), audit-only, nothing wired; no fit.
tier: scope-(a) refutation of a derivation route (exact closed-form structure + Lean-proved order/parity facts); no fit

A_borromean_closed_form.meaning: leading h⁴=h^{2(A−1)} (Milnor depth); the h⁸=h^{n-1} Ocneanu weight prefactor is ABSENT — τ_A is a normalized ratio, the weight CANCELS. Deficit bar-even ⇒ sign is a coefficient effect, not a bar-parity flip.

verdict.classification: scope-(a) REFUTATION of the weight-parity ⇒ deficit-sign route.
verdict.reason: the (q−q⁻¹)^{n-1} weight prefactor cancels in the normalized trace τ_A and is higher-order than the deficit — it cannot set the deficit's leading sign.
verdict.convergence_not_derivation: the (−1)^{A−1} match is a convergence via distinct mechanisms (weight-prefactor parity vs Milnor commutator depth), NOT a derivation. Sharpens #4399 Tie B.
verdict.sign_law_status: the Milnor-parity sign law (#4389) remains OPEN (A=4 measured); this refutes ONE candidate derivation route, not the derivability itself.
